subject.title: add option for MCP apps support

question: Should OpenClaw land full interactive MCP Apps through this in-memory, session-bound bridge, or sponsor the narrower durable view-only phase in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104742 first?
rationale: The two branches add materially different persistence and app-to-host capability boundaries across core configuration, Gateway lifecycle, browser sandboxing, and user behavior; code review cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Land full bridge after fixes
options.body: Keep this PR's default-off interactive app-to-MCP bridge and require the concrete lifecycle, backoff, capability, conflict, dependency, and upgrade fixes before merge.

options.title: Adopt view-only phase first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104742 as the initial host surface and defer app-to-server calls until its durable storage and capability contract is extended.

options.title: Pause both implementations
options.body: Defer core MCP Apps support until maintainers define persistence, sandbox-origin, plugin, and app-call policy as one design.

recommendation.title: Land full bridge after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's default-off interactive app-to-MCP bridge and require the concrete lifecycle, backoff, capability, conflict, dependency, and upgrade fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He implemented and hardened the current branch, authorized its official dependency, and is the strongest available owner for choosing between the two host boundaries.
